div.span: 3. Error page: - can be added at specific route level and at global level
Error.tsx page in next.js, receives two args: -

li.span: error: - this err object contains a digest hash, for the error that happens on the server(during SSR or in server Component) to into server logs, rather than sending the sensitive errors to client
reset: - A function to try rendering that route segment again

div.span: the clild page error just bubble up to the parent so the error page in the parent folder will handle all its nested pages errors or we can create different error page for every nested page
The same error page can/will also handle the error in the client component

text.tspan: 3. Error page: - can be added at specific route level and
at global level
Error.tsx page in next.js, receives two args: -
error: - this err object contains a digest hash, for the
error that happens on the server(during SSR or in
server Component) to into server logs, rather than
sending the sensitive errors to clientreset: - A function to
try rendering that route segment again
the clild page error just bubble up to the parent so the
error page in the parent folder will handle all its nested
pages errors or we can create different error page for
every nested page
The same error page can/will also handle the error in
the client component
